title: Admin contribution (registries/dashboard/*.yaml) - DRAFT
description: Declarative UI a plugin adds to an admin surface: the HAXcms dashboard (app-hax) or the site editor's admin screens. Core renders it with elements it already has (simple-icon-button-lite, simple-tooltip, simple-modal, accent-card, hax-element-demo, simple-icon-lite, and the HAX UI admin primitives in the site editor), so the plugin ships no front-end code. Data comes from the plugin's own operations through the surface's API layer, which adds the credentials.

surface.description: dashboard: app-hax, system scope, filled from GET /system/api/v1/plugins/contributions. site: the site editor's admin screens for one site, filled from GET /x/api/v1/plugins/contributions; only plugins enabled for that site contribute.

placement.description: dashboard surface: topbar (an icon button in the top bar's right group, before the user menu) or userMenu (an entry in the user menu). site surface: siteMenu (an entry in the site editor's admin menu, opening its action in the hax-ui modal) or slot (fills one of the named slots core admin screens promise to keep; see slot).

label.description: Accessible name and tooltip; translatable through the plugin's locale overlay.

badge.description: A chip on the button while there is something undismissed. The dashboard keeps { seenVersion, dismissedVersion } in user scaffold long-term memory under dismissKey; the chip shows while dismissedVersion is missing or older than the field's value (dotted-number compare).

operation.description: Omit for a badge that shows until dismissed (a tour).

from.description: Dot path in the first section's response to a map of { id: { label, icon, color } } shown as filter chips.

title.description: May use {{field}} from the badge operation's response.

items.description: Dot path to the array in the response; omit when the response is a single item.

chip.description: Dot path to a { label, icon, color } object, usually types[{{type}}]; rendered with label and icon, never color alone.

visual.description: Field holding { mode: element, tag } (rendered by hax-element-demo) or { mode: screenshot, url, alt } (url relative to the plugin's routes).

anchor.description: Field used as the card id, so Merlin can open the modal on one entry.

dismiss.description: A footer button that records the badge value as dismissed and closes the modal. Closing without it records seen only.

oneOf.description: A guided tour: the dashboard highlights each anchor in turn with the step's title and text. Progress is kept in user scaffold memory under the contribution's badge dismissKey, so a tour needs no backend.

anchor.description: Stable dashboard anchors app-hax promises to keep (data-hax-anchor attributes). Plugins never target other parts of the dashboard.

oneOf.description: A button that calls one of the plugin's operations and shows the outcome in the surface's status line (or a toast on the dashboard). No modal.

body.description: Fixed request body; may use {{scope}} (the screen's current scope, such as the page and its children) where the screen has one.

confirm.description: Optional question shown before the call; translatable.

done.description: Status text after success; may use {{field}} from the response.

slot.description: Required with placement: slot. Stable slots core admin screens promise to keep, the way app-hax keeps its anchors. site-settings.panel: a panel in the site settings screen. insights.section: an extra section in the Insights navigation, rendered from the action's sections. insights.action: a button in the Insights controls bar; use action kind run.

order.description: Position among contributions in the same placement or slot (lower first); ties keep cascade order.
